text: I can set this up, but "help patients" could mean several things.

questions: Which outcome should show whether it helps? ED attendances are the only outcome in this dataset; for example, the number of attendances, or whether a patient attended at all.
Over what follow-up period? 12 months after enrolment is a common choice.
Should the study be limited to some patients, such as adults or patients with diabetes?

text: Thanks. I'll use any ED attendance in the 12 months after enrolment, for adults with diabetes.

features.name: prior_ed
features.label: ED attendances in the 12 months before

features.name: any_ed_after
features.label: Any ED attendance in the 12 months after

text: The study is ready: adults with diabetes, Programme A against matched non-members, outcome any ED attendance in the 12 months after enrolment. I also adjusted for age, gender and prior ED use. Review it in the builder before running it.
